ACT III OF 1999
GALIYAT DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1999
ACT III OF 1999
An Act to amend the
Galiyat Development Authority Act, 1996
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 8th March, 1999].
No.PA/NWFP/Legis.I/99/4839. dated
8-3-1999.---The Galiyat Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1999, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on 16th
February, 1999 and assented to by the Governor of North-West Frontier Province
on the 3rd March, 1999, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Galiyat Development
Authority (Amendment) Act, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 9 of N.W.F.P. Act No. VII of 1996

ACT III OF 1999
An Act to amend the
Galiyat Development Authority Act, 1996
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 8th March, 1999].
No.PA/NWFP/Legis.I/99/4839. dated
8-3-1999.---The Galiyat Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1999, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on 16th
February, 1999 and assented to by the Governor of North-West Frontier Province
on the 3rd March, 1999, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 9 of
N.-W.F.P. Act-.No. VII of 1996.--In the Galiyat Development Authority Act,
1996 (N.-W.F.P. Act No. VII of 1996), hereinafter referred to as the said Act,
in section 9, after subsection (2) the following new subsection shall be added,
namely:
"(3) Notwithstanding the
provisions contained in subsections (1) and (2), till such time as the
Director-General is appointed, the Commissioner, Hazara Division, shall also
act as Director-General of the Authority."

Amendment of section 13 of N.W.F.P. Act No. VII of 1996

GALIYAT DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1999
ACT III OF 1999
An Act to amend the
Galiyat Development Authority Act, 1996
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 8th March, 1999].
No.PA/NWFP/Legis.I/99/4839. dated
8-3-1999.---The Galiyat Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1999, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on 16th
February, 1999 and assented to by the Governor of North-West Frontier Province
on the 3rd March, 1999, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
3. Amendment of section 13 of
N.-W.F.P. Act VII of 1996.--In the said Act, the existing section 13 shall
be re-numbered as subsection (1) of section 13 and after subsection (1), as so
renumbered, the following new subsections shall be added, namely:--
(2) A scheme prepared under
subsection (1) shall be subject to the following conditions and restrictions:
(a) no residential plot shall be
of an area of less than two Kanals, nor shall any such plot be sub-divided to
reduce the plot size to an area of less than two Kanals; provided that this
restriction shall not apply in relation to those plots where lawful
construction work started before the commencement of this Act;
(b) the covered area of any plot,
whether residential or commercial, shall not exceed one-third of the total area
of the plot;
(c) no residential building
raised on a plot shall be of more than two sforeys and the covered area of the
top storey shall not exceed half of the covered area of the ground floor; and
(d) no construction in the area
shall be made unless the detailed plan of construction alongwith the site plan
thereof is approved by the Authority.
(3) All constructions, whether
for residential or commercial purpose, in the area shall strictly be in
accordance with the scheme and the land use plan prepared by the Authority.
(4) No excavation or land
levelling in the area shall be made, except with the prior approval of the
Authority.
(5) No construction, of
whatsoever nature, shall be permissible in the area known as Lalazar situated
between Nathiagali and Mukshpuri and on the main road leading from Abbottabad
and Murree contrary to West Pakistan Highway Ordinance, 1959. ".
